debug_methods.debug_load_fixture(name:String): Load a fixed First Build rule fixture.
debug_methods.debug_step(seconds:float): Advance production rules by exact fixed ticks, independent from render FPS.
debug_methods.debug_set_move_vector(v:Vector2): Set semantic movement vector without screen coordinates.
debug_methods.debug_cast(angle_degrees:float)->bool: Invoke production Cast rule without touch mapping.
debug_methods.debug_launch_tool(tool:String,angle_degr: Launch Redirect/Split pulse through production rule logic.
debug_methods.debug_pause(value:bool): Set Pause through production state transition.
debug_methods.debug_retry(): Restore fixed Wave2 initial rule state.

compatibility: New read-only observers are compatible extensions; changing rule semantics is not.
